selected_post.validated_payload:
Your apps. Your config. Your machine.

Helm stores everything in a local JSON file. Nothing leaves your device. No account. No sync.

get-helm.app
selected_post.visual_asset_suggestion: Use the 'Menu Bar Popover UI' design prompt. Show idle state. Optionally overlay the config path ~/Library/Application Support/Helm/workflows.json in JetBrains Mono below the popover — Fog color, small size.

selection_rationale: ownership_trinity selected first: local sovereignty angle is Helm's strongest differentiator and most defensible claim. Zero competitors can make this statement while also having a cloud sync option. Leads with what no one else can say.
